name: frotzlarge
description: frotz(6) plays Book and Volume (Nick Montfort, 2005, CC BY-NC-SA 2.5; 225,792 bytes, Z-machine v5) -- the LARGE-STORY regression.  The story far exceeds the 64 KB data bank, so its routines and strings live above 64 KB in the bank-spanning Memory Manager block: exactly what Mini-Cluedo (16 KB) and CZECH do not exercise.  The script begins a session from the title menu (B), looks, asks the score and quits; 'glow-in-the-dark stars' and '0 of the 0 tasks' print only if code and strings above 64 KB were reached, and the returned prompt proves the quit unwinds.  Runs the shipped copy at /usr/games/frotz.
